found_at: https://app.shorten.rest/auth (<meta name="msapplication-TileImage" content="./assets/favicon/270x270.jpg">; the same page links 32, 180 and 192px copies)
notes: Replaces the current file, a 'Shorten.REST' wordmark PNG in black that vanishes on the dark theme, with the app mark. 270px is the largest copy (the search found the 192px one, downloads/shorten-rest/s2-2); it is a JPG, so its white square is part of the file: it shows as a white tile on the dark theme with the black S on it. DECISION: two marks exist. The marketing site shorten.rest uses a different one, a white 'S' on a blue #3b82f6 rounded tile, but only as favicon.svg/apple-touch-icon.svg drawing the S as live <text> in IBM Plex Mono (not outlined), with no raster copy; the app and docs use this black S. If the reviewer prefers the blue tile, nothing usable exists yet.
license: Shorten.REST brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Shorten.REST.
